# Jupyter Notebook Mode

Activates an interactive Jupyter notebook environment for data exploration and code execution.

## Usage
- Launches a Jupyter kernel for running Python cells interactively
- Supports inline visualizations with matplotlib, seaborn, and plotly
- Enables iterative prototyping of data pipelines and ML experiments
- Automatically saves notebook outputs for reproducibility
